subject: Request to move demo window — customer VP availability update
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Johnson <eric.johnson@stratasync.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo on April 9 — draft agenda and timing

Hi Eric —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, we penciled in a 60-minute product demo on Friday, Apr 9 at 10:00 AM PT to accommodate your team. Attached is a short agenda and an exec-briefing runbook for the session (demo-agenda.pdf, runbook-exec-briefing.xlsx).

Goal for the session: show the end-to-end inference flow for your retrieval use case, run a short latency/cost walkthrough, and leave 15 minutes for deployment/ops Q&A.

If that slot works for you I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in Karthik from our architecture team to run the ops portion. If your VP needs to join, happy to nudge timing — just let me know his/her availability.

Next steps
- Confirm whether 10:00 AM PT on 4/9 works for the core team
- Confirm if VP/CTO will join (we’ll reserve a 15–20 minute executive brief at the top)

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (7KB), runbook-exec-briefing.xlsx (12KB)
From: Eric Johnson <eric.johnson@stratasync.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@stratasync.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo on April 9 — draft agenda and timing

Camila —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear agenda. Quick update: our VP of Engineering (Maya) just shifted travel and asked to attend — she’ll only be available the morning of Apr 9 PT but needs the slot moved 30 minutes earlier to make a connection. Would you be able to start at 9:30 AM PT instead of 10:00?

If that’s tight on your side, we can also look at Apr 12 in the morning; Maya prefers to keep it this week if possible.

Either way, we’ll have a short pre-demo sync with our platform lead (I’ll send a note) so the right folks are on the call.

Appreciate it —
Eric
Sr. Product Manager, StrataSync
eric.johnson@stratasync.com

Karthik / Ava —

Looping you both in: customer VP (Maya Patel) can join but asked to move the demo to 9:30 AM PT on 4/9 (30 minutes earlier). Can you confirm if Karthik can join at 9:30 for the executive brief + ops run? If Karthik is booked, Marissa is available to lead exec section and handle the KV/cache deep-dive.

Proposed structure if we move to 9:30 AM PT:
- 9:30–9:45 Executive brief (Maya + customer execs) — high-level ROI and risk mitigation
- 9:45–10:25 Product demo + architecture walkthrough (Karthik or Marissa)
- 10:25–10:40 Ops/implementation Q&A

We’ll update the invite and attach the short exec one-pager to the calendar. Can you reply with a quick thumbs (yes/no) so I can lock the slot on their calendar?

Thanks —
Camila

Eric / Maya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We’ve moved the demo to Fri, Apr 9 at 9:30 AM PT and updated the agenda to include a 15-minute exec brief at the top. Invite sent (calendar link above). Karthik will lead the architecture walkthrough; Marissa will cover the ops deep-dive if Karthik needs to step out briefly. Ava will run the meeting and manage the recording.

Attachments: one-slide-exec-summary.pdf (3KB) — included on the calendar; please review ahead of time. Karthik, Eric — I’ve also created a small test bucket mock and shared the S3 path in the HubSpot deal notes for you to ingest before the demo.

If anything changes on your side, tell me and we can pivot to Apr 12 AM as a backup. Looking forward to it.

Best —
